title: S13 scope and evidence classes
body: P01 is central, P02 guided, P03 optional and Regression Harness is launched for completion before S14.

title: Package, runtime and assessed path
body: Record package identity, actual Node/browser state and the one assessed P01 file. Missing infrastructure is a block, not a pass.

title: Lifecycle prediction
body: Map caller, client, worker, pending owner, request ID and every terminal path before coding.

title: Fail before worker creation
body: Invalid values and a pre-aborted signal must reject without creating a worker or sending a message.

title: One owned module Worker
body: Create the worker lazily and keep DOM work on the main thread.

title: Pending before postMessage
body: The fake Worker can reply synchronously. Pending state must exist before the send.

title: Out-of-order completion
body: Opaque request IDs preserve caller/result ownership when completion order changes.

title: Monotonic non-terminal messages
body: Accept only monotonic progress for the matching request and do not settle the promise.

title: Cancel locally and cooperatively
body: Abort rejects once, removes local ownership and sends one cancel envelope when possible.

title: Stable public errors
body: Worker error and messageerror reject pending work without exposing raw event details. State the worker-retirement policy.

title: Terminate and clean
body: Dispose rejects pending work, removes listeners, terminates the worker and is idempotent.

title: Independent P01 observations
body: Record exact baseline, objective, regression and browser-integration status. Fake Worker evidence is not real responsiveness.

title: Bounded Gemini critique
body: Use one sanitised lifecycle claim and a minimal excerpt. Preserve the actual response or pending state.

title: Verdict and correction
body: Choose ACCEPTED, REJECTED, PARTIALLY ACCEPTED or UNKNOWN, then state a corrected claim and limitation.

title: P02 trace and Regression Harness launch
body: Trace controlled versus uncontrolled Service Worker state, then record the U14 harness target, matrix and mutation candidate.

title: Evidence draft and STOP
body: Save an honest draft, list unfinished P01 and portfolio work and stop at minute 60.
